label: OBS parallel development policy
description: Decision policy allowing main development to continue in parallel with manual and agent-assisted observation work.
rules: Track B may continue after Track A and OBS replan
manual observations need not block all development
agent-assisted observation candidates may run in parallel with Track B
first live connector requires explicit source approval
observations feed SearchNeed WorkUnit Candidate or EvidencePack fixtures after review
observations and candidates do not directly mutate the master index
human approval remains required for evidence-quality and source-policy decisions
